page.title: Comprehensive Next.js 14 App Router Rendering Guide
page.subtitle: How BBC News selects the optimal rendering strategy for each type of news content to achieve ultra-fast Time To First Byte (TTFB < 20ms) while guaranteeing real-time data accuracy.

gsr.title: GSR (Static SSG)
gsr.subtitle: Generated Static Rendering
gsr.desc: The page is fully pre-built during compile time and cached as static HTML on global Edge CDNs.

isr.title: ISR (Incremental Static)
isr.subtitle: Incremental Static Regeneration
isr.desc: Combines static SSG speed on CDN with background revalidation at specified intervals.

ssr.title: SSR (Dynamic Server)
ssr.subtitle: Server-Side Rendering
ssr.desc: The page is rendered dynamically on a Node.js server or Edge Worker for every incoming user request.

csr.title: CSR (Client Realtime)
csr.subtitle: Client-Side Rendering
csr.desc: Renders components interactively inside the user's browser client via JavaScript execution.

modal.title: Next.js 14 App Router Rendering Modes Comparison
modal.subtitle: Interactive comparison across the 4 strategies in large-scale news applications
